description: Find the ENS name an address uses (reverse resolution), e.g. 'Which ENS name does 0xd8dA… have?'. Takes up to 50 addresses. A name counts only if it resolves back to the address, so a reverse record cannot claim someone else's name. Returns null for an address without a primary name.

coin.description: Chain of the primary name, e.g. base or op for a name set on that L2. Default: eth

name: get_primary_name

coin.description: Coin symbol such as eth, btc, sol, base or op, or a numeric coin type (ENSIP-9/11)

anyOf.description: ENS name as the user wrote it, e.g. nick.eth; normalised by the server (ENSIP-15)

name.description: The primary name; null when it has none

title: Get primary ENS names
